description: Search UK companies at Companies House by name or keywords. Returns an object with a results array; each result has id (company:<number>, pass it to fetch), title (company name, number and status) and url (the company page on registrum.co.uk). Up to 10 results, in relevance order; results is empty when nothing matches. Use fetch on an id to read the company.

query.description: Company name or keywords to search for

name: search
title: Search companies
